# VPSLedger

> True monthly VPS cost (base + IPv4 + backups + overage), 33 plans, 26 verified, 15 providers, checked 2026-10-26.

- [Plans JSON](https://vpsledger.pages.dev/api/plans.json)
- [Calculator](https://vpsledger.pages.dev/calculator.html)
- [Methodology](https://vpsledger.pages.dev/methodology.html)

- Kamatera Basic: $4.00/mo (https://www.kamatera.com/pricing/)

- Linode / Akamai Nanode 1 GB: $5.00/mo (https://api.linode.com/v4/linode/types)
- AWS Lightsail Linux 0.5 GB: $5.00/mo (https://aws.amazon.com/lightsail/pricing/)
- DigitalOcean Basic 1 GB: $6.00/mo (https://www.digitalocean.com/pricing/droplets)
